title: VPN drops intermittently on macOS 15.1
description: User reported VPN keeps disconnecting after waking from sleep.
root_cause: Dead session lock in Palo Alto gateway session table.
outcome: Resolved successfully after session reset and client reconnect.

title: Git clone fails on internal mirror port 8080
description: Connection refused when attempting to pull internal repo from git.corp.internal:8080.
root_cause: auth_proxy daemon crashed due to high memory footprint.
outcome: Service restarted following Tier-2 approval; port 8080 reopened.

title: Laptop purple artifacts and kernel crash
description: Screen distorted and crashed with kernel code 0x889FA.
root_cause: Faulty GPU solder / hardware memory error.
outcome: Escalated to Tier-2 Hardware Provisioning for replacement laptop.

title: Suspected unauthorized account login from foreign IP
description: User reported suspicious access alert and unfamiliar login from foreign location.
root_cause: Compromised session token / credential stuffing attempt.
outcome: Escalated to Tier-2 SecOps; account locked and MFA reset initiated by security analyst.
